entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $7.68 per shift, capped at $38.19 per week, for nominated first aid duties.

conditions.text: Employee holds the required current first aid certificate and is requested or nominated to act as first aider.

entitlements.title: Firearm allowance
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $3.84 per shift, capped at $19.21 per week, when firearm duties are required.

conditions.text: Employee is required to carry a firearm in performing their duties.

entitlements.title: Broken shift allowance
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $18.30 for a rostered shift worked in two periods of duty.

conditions.text: Rostered shift is split into two periods of duty, excluding rest breaks.

entitlements.title: Supervision allowance (1-5 employees)
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $47.68 per week for supervising 1 to 5 employees.

conditions.text: Employee is required to supervise 1 to 5 employees.

entitlements.title: Supervision allowance (6-10 employees)
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $55.02 per week for supervising 6 to 10 employees.

conditions.text: Employee is required to supervise 6 to 10 employees.

entitlements.title: Supervision allowance (11-20 employees)
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $71.40 per week for supervising 11 to 20 employees.

conditions.text: Employee is required to supervise 11 to 20 employees.

entitlements.title: Supervision allowance (more than 20 employees)
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $84.28 per week for supervising more than 20 employees.

conditions.text: Employee is required to supervise more than 20 employees.

entitlements.title: Relieving officer allowance
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $47.23 per week to a relieving officer.

conditions.text: Employee is appointed or engaged as a relieving officer under the award.

entitlements.title: Aviation allowance
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $2.11 per hour for qualifying aviation security duties.

conditions.text: Employee performs work that meets the award aviation allowance condition.

entitlements.title: Meal allowance
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $22.14 when qualifying unnotified overtime is worked.

conditions.text: Employee works more than one hour after their ordinary shift without notice on or before the previous day.

entitlements.title: Vehicle allowance (motor vehicle)
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $1.00 per kilometre for required use of an employee-owned motor vehicle.

conditions.text: Employer requires the employee to use their own motor vehicle in performing duties.

entitlements.title: Vehicle allowance (motorcycle)
entitlements.plainLanguage: Pays $0.34 per kilometre for required use of an employee-owned motorcycle.

conditions.text: Employer requires the employee to use their own motorcycle in performing duties.
